venue: Family Dog at the Great Highway
lineage: Reel Master (Studer A80) > Sonoma Systems DSD > Dobly Stretched Decode > WAV (24-bit/96k)Mastering Info:WAV > Adobe Audition CC 2015 > Samplitude Pro X3 Suite > FLAC/24

ai_review.summary: Crystal‑clear soundboard capture of a historic 1969 show featuring a soaring Dark Star and guest horn/violin magic, despite a few rough opening numbers.
ai_review.review: The recording is praised for its exceptional clarity and immersive mix, likely sourced from the original half‑track master transferred by Rob Eaton. Musically the concert shines after an uneven start, with a breathtaking Dark Star that leads into an inspired Other One and memorable guest sax/violin contributions, making it a standout document of this era.

ai_rating.rationale: All six reviewers are overwhelmingly positive (five 5‑star, one 4‑star), highlighting both superb sound quality and exceptional performances; the weighted average therefore sits near the top of the scale.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers repeatedly note crystal‑clear, immersive audio with no major glitches; a few mention the first couple of songs sound rough but overall the mix is pristine.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Starts a bit uneven, then launches into an epic Dark Star that sets a high‑energy tone for the rest of the set, highlighted by guest horn/violin textures and strong Pigpen numbers.
